Chapter 970 Chapter 26 Who Is Landing? (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 970  Chapter 26 Who is Landing? (Subscribe Please)

"Excellent, excellent, excellent."

With a splendid smile, the Ancient Power Supreme Being Xia Qin was overjoyed. The reappearance of Lin Yuan before their eyes meant he had successfully ascended to the twelfth layer.

However, hearing Lin Yuan personally acknowledge this fact, Xia Qin felt an unprecedented sense of satisfaction in his heart.

After more than a million years, has human civilization finally given birth to its tenth ultimate being?

Wrong.

Lin Yuan's existence cannot merely be described as that of an ultimate being.

"Respect, respect," whispered the Void God Ultimate Being. "Galaxy Master, you've only been an evolver for a mere thousand years and have already reached the final threshold. I wouldn't have dared to think this possible in the past."

Putting aside Lin Yuan's combat prowess, just the speed with which he has entered the twelfth layer is enough to set a precedent not found in countless Cosmic Eras.

Not to mention, the evolutionary path Lin Yuan follows is one he carved out himself from nothing, which is countless times more difficult than the stable ultimate evolutionary routes that other twelfth layer beings follow.

"Less than a thousand years? When I was a thousand, I wasn't even at the eighth layer," sighed a human ultimate being. It sounded like self-mockery, but his expression was extraordinarily pleased.

Because Lin Yuan is an evolver of their human civilization.

"Just luck," Lin Yuan modestly said.

"Strength is strength, what luck is there to talk about," said Xuanyuan Supreme, shaking his head.

"Indeed, Galaxy Master, you don't have to be modest. It's a fact that we are far inferior to you," the Void God Ultimate Being nodded in agreement.

"Galaxy Master, there's something I'd like to ask of you," said the Ancient Power Supreme Being, unable to help himself as he looked at Lin Yuan.

"Please speak," Lin Yuan replied, his expression slightly solemn.

"Galaxy Master, you had the combat power of the twelfth layer while you were at the eleventh. Now that you have entered the twelfth layer, what level has your combat power reached?" the Ancient Power Supreme Being asked with a gleam of combativeness in his eyes.

He himself had ascended to the ultimate layer through the path of strength, barely on par with Xia Qin in terms of combat power, and was naturally curious about Lin Yuan's true strength at the moment.

"Exactly, what level of strength do you have now, Galaxy Master?" the Void God Ultimate Being also looked forward with anticipation.

Neither the Ancient Power Supreme Being nor the Void God Ultimate Being bore any ill will or dissatisfaction toward Lin Yuan; they were merely curious to know what level he had reached.

In the history of the universe, there have been only a few dozen ultimate beings at the twelfth layer, and most of them were incapable of besting one another.

"In this universe, it's roughly equivalent to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm," Lin Yuan said casually.

The peak of the Path Splitting Realm, only hindered by the compression of the universe. In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan could easily unleash the power of a sovereign realm.

"The peak of the Path Splitting Realm?"

"Just entering the twelfth layer and already at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm?"

The Ancient Power Supreme Being was extremely astonished. Like other ultimate beings of the twelfth layer, the nine human ultimate beings were certain that Lin Yuan would quickly reach the peak of the Path Splitting Realm after ascending to the twelfth layer.

But to reach the peak of the Path Splitting Realm upon entry?

Isn't it said that the moment of entering the ultimate level of the twelfth layer is the weakest?

"We could have a sparring match," Lin Yuan offered with a smile, not minding satisfying the curiosity of the human ultimate beings.

"Alright."

"Then I'll go first," said the Ancient Power Supreme Being, invigorated, speaking directly.

In the universe, only the two members of the Robber Clan had reached the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

However, those two faced many restrictions when taking action. If they did not make a move, they would not be pressured, but once they did, they would have to face the suppression of the cosmic consciousness, hence they would go all out.

An all-out peak Path Splitting Realm being... The Ancient Power Supreme Being wasn't foolish enough to provoke them willingly.

But Lin Yuan... as a fellow human civilization ultimate being, the Ancient Power Supreme Being believed that Lin Yuan wouldn't go all out against him.

"You go first or shall I?" Lin Yuan asked, nodding his head.

"You go ahead," the Ancient Power Supreme Being said earnestly.

Facing a peak Path Splitting Realm being, one must primarily focus on defense. Only by doing so can one truly experience the power of the peak Path Splitting Realm.

"I'll just use the power of my body," said Lin Yuan, raising his right hand and casually pressing towards the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

Boom, boom, boom.

The terrifying physical strength began to affect the fabric of space-time. The Ancient Power Supreme Being, with a tingling scalp, resisted with all his might, trying to affect Lin Yuan's slowly descending right hand, but to no avail.

Next, the Ancient Power Supreme Being attempted to escape but realized that space-time had already formed a cage. The sheer power of a tremendous physical body, with a simple dispersal of vital energy, was enough to warp space-time, creating a realm unique to Lin Yuan.

Whoosh.

As Lin Yuan's hand pressed down slowly, in the eyes of the Ancient Power Supreme Being, it was as if the universe itself was collapsing, his entire field of vision saturated with this one palm.

"Stop, stop, stop," the Ancient Power Supreme Being immediately exclaimed.

He still had many trump cards he hadn't used, but to call them forth would be beyond a mere spar, so the Ancient Power Supreme Being conceded directly.

"Galaxy Master, please stop," said the Void God Ultimate Being, steadying his spirit rapidly.

He had planned to step forward and exchange a few blows with the Galaxy Master after the Ancient Power Supreme Being had his spar.

But now, it seemed there was no need for such self-humiliation.

"The peak of the Path Splitting Realm, is it so terrifying?" With Lin Yuan retracting his hand, the Ancient Power Supreme Being couldn't help but marvel.

Under that single palm, the Ancient Power Supreme Being felt that even if he used his most powerful trump card, he would still be injured—and that was merely Lin Yuan's casual press.

"The peak of the Path Splitting Realm..."

Xuanyuan Supreme looked deeply at Lin Yuan.

The peak of the Path Splitting Realm wasn't supposed to be this frightening; what was truly terrifying was the Galaxy Master.

"Since the Galaxy Master has now successfully advanced to the Twelfth Order, we will take our leave first," the Xuanyuan Supreme declared.

They, the nine of them, had originally planned to stay a bit longer since reaching the ultimate level of the Twelfth Order often marks the weakest moment.

If other ultimate beings at the Twelfth Order took the opportunity to attack, it would be troublesome.

That's why the protection of nine Supreme Beings was needed to guard against such ultimate entities of the Twelfth Order.

But now, after Lin Yuan struck with his palm just a moment earlier, the idea of protection immediately vanished from the minds of the Xuanyuan Supreme and other Supreme Beings.

Protection?

Who protects whom?

Were they protecting the Galaxy Master, or was the Galaxy Master protecting them?

"I will come to find you after some time," Lin Yuan nodded.

Having ascended to the Twelfth Order, he had many things to do.

"Hmm."

The Xuanyuan Supreme looked at Lin Yuan, as if recalling something, and then immediately said, "Galaxy Master, having just ascended to the Twelfth Order, you must quickly make your way to converge with the Time River Space."

Upon a successful breakthrough to the ultimate level of Level Eleven Perfect, life fundamentally transforms, breaking free from the suppression of the Time River, enabling direct entry into the space where the Time River is located.

What follows for every new ultimate being at the Twelfth Order is the act of making landfall.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan replied.

Making landfall was also the very first thing he was going to do shortly. Although the influence of the Time River is minimal on newly ascended life forms of the Twelfth Order due to their recent transformation, the sooner the landing is made, the better.

Swish, swish, swish.

The Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight Supreme Beings left one after the other.

Suddenly, only Lin Yuan was left standing alone under the starry sky.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan sensed many observations; those were numerous ultimate beings of the Twelfth Order cautiously inspecting him.

"Robber Clan?"

Lin Yuan's gaze turned towards the territory of the Robber Clan; at this moment, with the leap in the level of his life, he could see much more. The myriad of information contained within the seemingly ordinary wooden house startled him.

"The origins of the Robber Clan are definitely not simple. Could this wooden house be a treasure of the Chaos Realm level?" Lin Yuan speculated in his heart.

"Congratulations, Galaxy Master, for ascending to the Twelfth Order," at this moment, an ultimate being from the Robber Clan voiced transmission across more than half the Cosmic Era offering blessings.

"Congratulations, Galaxy Master, for ascending to the Twelfth Order," another ultimate being from the Robber Clan's voice also came through.

"The tone of these two..." Lin Yuan faintly perceived a trace of... respect? in the voices of these two ultimate beings from the Robber Clan.

This was somewhat inconceivable, as the two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan were also at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm; even if they were unable to take direct action, they shouldn't be overly fearful of Lin Yuan.

Moreover, the wooden house of the Chaos Realm level?

"If the Galaxy Master has time, you are welcome to visit us. We shall spare no detail in our explanations," an ultimate being of the Robber Clan standing outside the wooden house immediately said.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded

He was not worried about any traps.

After ascending to the Twelfth Order, Lin Yuan had no adversaries in this universe, and even if he were to go to the territory of the Robber Clan, he would not visit in person. At most, he would send an avatar in his stead.

...

"It's time to land."

With a thought, Lin Yuan entered the space of the Time River.

On the banks of the Time River.

Versatile ultimate beings of the Twelfth Order stood firmly, all watching the happenings within the Time River.

Now that the Galaxy Master had successfully ascended to the Twelfth Order, the next step would presumably be landing?

The many ultimate beings of different races couldn't directly comprehend Lin Yuan's strength like the strongest protectors of human civilization could, so they could only judge based on the spectacle of Lin Yuan's landing.

Within the Time River, any life manifests in its most fundamental form, both under and above the Time River it is so.

The higher the essence of life, the larger its form in the Time River.

"Is that—"

Suddenly, an ultimate being of the Prison Tribe watched, shocked, as it gazed at the central location of the Time River.

There, a gigantic figure slowly began to straighten up; this giant was immensely vast and tall, with its legs still submerged in the Time River upon standing. The height of the river's water could only reach its thighs, and the width of its legs spanned the entire Time River.

Boom, boom, boom.

After this giant stood up, it lifted its right foot and walked towards the banks of the Time River.

The giant was so vast in size that the ultimate beings on the bank only reached its knees.

During the landing, the enormous size implies absolute massiveness; the entire bank of the Time River trembled faintly under the pressure of the giant's steps.

The slight trembling, following the giant's every step, spread along the Time River towards a distant span.

In a flash.

The tremors of the Time River where the giant resided propagated to other tributaries of the Time River, which passed through other universes.

The ultimate beings within each universe felt this vibration, and a thought emerged in their hearts in unison:

"Who is making landfall?"
